from: September book, night 2 (This Is the Day)
p1: Long ago, the Lord’s people sang a happy song. It began, “O give thanks to the Lord, for He is good.”
Then they sang, “This is the day which the Lord has made. We will be happy and glad in it.”
The Lord who made each day is Jesus. He made the world for Heavenly Father. So every morning is a gift from Him.
p2: The song does not say, “a perfect day.” It says “this day,” the one we have right now. Even on a rainy day, we can find something to be glad about.
Think back on today. What made you smile? Tell Heavenly Father thank you for that happy thing.
old: One morning, a happy song-writer woke up and looked at the brand-new day. The sun was shining, the birds were singing, and his heart felt full of joy.
“This is the day that Heavenly Father made!” he sang. “I will be happy and glad in it!”
He knew that every single day is a gift from Heavenly Father. Some days are big and exciting; some days are quiet and small. But every day is made by Him.
“Thank You, Heavenly Father, for You are so good!” the person sang. “Your love lasts forever and ever!”
When you wake up tomorrow, you can remember: this new day is a gift, made just for you by Heavenly Father who loves you.
